summary: Glucotrack filed an 8-K reporting a registered direct offering under its Form S-3 shelf: 169,388 shares at $2.04 and pre-funded warrants for 1,350,220 shares at $2.039 (exercise price $0.001, immediately exercisable, expiring when fully exercised), for gross proceeds of approximately $3.1 million before placement agent fees and expenses. Dawson James Securities acted as placement agent; closing was expected September 25, 2026. Net proceeds will retire existing debt with the remainder for working capital. The purchase agreement includes customary lock-up covenants on future issuances and registration statement filings. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and warrant overhang.
